constructor.details: Call path: deployment script -> InteractionPool.constructor; thendeployment script -> InteractionPool.configureDependencies.

executeDailyBuyback().details: Call path: keeperany caller -> InteractionPool.executeDailyBuyback -> UniswapV2Router.swapExactTokensForTokensSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens -> dead -> TradingModeController.checkAndSwitchMode.

executeDailyLiquidity().details: Call path: keeperany caller -> InteractionPool.executeDailyLiquidity -> PriceOracle.quoteUsdtToMobSpot -> UniswapV2Router.addLiquidity -> TradingModeController.checkAndSwitchMode.

notifyUsdtInflow(uint256).details: Call path: CardManager/MiningSystem -> InteractionPool.notifyUsdtInflow -> TradingModeController.checkAndSwitchMode. TradingRouter Pair-sale inflow is checked only after the complete sale through TradingRouter.sellMob -> TradingModeController.recordPairSaleAndCheck.

paySaleUsdt(address,uint256).details: Call path: user -> TradingRouter.sellMob -> InteractionPool.paySaleUsdt -> USDT.safeTransfer.

proxiableUUID().details: Implementation of the ERC-1822 {proxiableUUID} function. This returns the storage slot used by the implementation. It is used to validate the implementation's compatibility when performing an upgrade. IMPORTANT: A proxy pointing at a proxiable contract should not be considered proxiable itself, because this risks bricking a proxy that upgrades to it, by delegating to itself until out of gas. Thus it is critical that this function revert if invoked through a proxy. This is guaranteed by the `notDelegated` modifier.

setBusinessAuthorization(address,bool).details: Call path: owner -> InteractionPool.setBusinessAuthorization; then -> InteractionPool.pay.

setOperator(address).details: Call path: deployment scriptowner -> InteractionPool.setOperator; owner.

setPairOutflowRecoveryMultipleBps(uint25.details: Call path: operator -> InteractionPool.setPairOutflowRecoveryMultipleBps; the value applies immediately.

setPoolBalanceRecoveryRatioBps(uint256).details: Call path: operator -> InteractionPool.setPoolBalanceRecoveryRatioBps; the value applies immediately.

setPoolToPairExitRatioBps(uint256).details: Call path: operator -> InteractionPool.setPoolToPairExitRatioBps; the value applies immediately.

setSwitchMultipliers(uint256,uint256,uin.details: Call path: operator -> InteractionPool.setSwitchMultipliers; TradingRouterkeeper Additional validation, accounting, and bounded-execution rules apply.

upgradeToAndCall(address,bytes).details: Upgrade the implementation of the proxy to `newImplementation`, and subsequently execute the function call encoded in `data`. Calls {_authorizeUpgrade}. Emits an {Upgraded} event.

setPairOutflowRecoveryMultipleBps(uint25.notice: Updates only the Pair outflow multiple used to leave Pair mode after a flow-triggered switch.

setPoolBalanceRecoveryRatioBps(uint256).notice: Updates only the pool-balance recovery ratio used to leave Pair mode.

setPoolToPairExitRatioBps(uint256).notice: Updates only the interaction-pool-to-Pair ratio used to enter Pair mode and gate daily keeper tasks.
